supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:25 UTC, WS-ZADAMS-01 made a successful proxy CONNECT to download.windowsupdate.com using a Windows Update Agent user agent; the tunnel transferred about 38.8 MB from the server to the client.

The Windows Update traffic is consistent with software updating near the reported PowerShell-window time, but the available records do not show that PowerShell ran or that the update caused the reported window.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon were not collected from WS-ZADAMS-01 during the entire 13:20–14:20 UTC review window because of a log collection outage.
The available network records show connections and proxy metadata, but do not identify the endpoint process or its command line.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ZADAMS-01, and if so, its command line, parent process, user, and actions.
Whether the Windows Update traffic was related to the briefly visible PowerShell window.
Whether any activity on the workstation during the telemetry outage was malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint process-creation and PowerShell logging for WS-ZADAMS-01 around 13:40 UTC, including parent process, command line, user, and script-block or transcript data if available.
Review EDR or forensic process, file, and persistence telemetry for WS-ZADAMS-01 covering the alert window.
Correlate the user’s report with workstation session records and any available update or patch-management logs.
unrelated_findings: FILE-SUN-01 initiated an RDP connection to WS-ZADAMS-01 at 13:41:23 UTC. The record establishes the connection but not who initiated it or whether it was authorized; track separately rather than treating it as evidence of the alerted PowerShell activity. (T234-00133)

PROXY-SUN-01 initiated an RDP connection to WS-ZADAMS-01 at 14:10:08 UTC; the same host also made connection attempts to workstation ports 80 and 22 nearby. These are separate from the reported 13:40 activity on the available evidence. (T234-00265, T234-00266, T234-00267)
